mentions.name: iPad Kids Tutor
mentions.description: This iPad app helps kids prepare for exams by letting them take a photo of a problem they struggle with and generating a plan for working through the issue, using Claude and Codex on the backend. It initially targets math problems but works for any subject, aiming to steer kids toward solving problems themselves rather than asking Gemini for solutions.
mentions.problem: Kids preparing for exams tend to ask Gemini for solutions instead of working through problems themselves; the builder's kids needed a way to get guided help on difficult problems.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve built an iPad Kids Tutor app. 
They can take a pic of a problem that they struggle with (initially for math but it works for any subject) and the harness then prepares a plan how to work through the issue using both claude and codex on the backend.
mentions.author: suls
